title: mcp: update_record and delete_record still answer an error after a landed write when the parent summary recompute fails, so an agent retries a change that already happened
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① open question of the #28782 dev (os-dev-report 6565619956, `open_questions`), answered by this seat as a follow-up card. Filed by `domain:server` seat 5. Graded by this seat: p2, the same class as #28661 / #28782 (a write that landed is answered as a failure, so the caller retries it), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: any MCP client (an agent) updating or deleting a record whose object feeds a summary roll-up, when the parent recompute fails after the write is stored.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/mcp`).

## What happens

PR #28843 (#28782) makes the MCP `create_record` tool read the answer the write earned through #28781's carrier (`earnedAnswerOf` on the `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE` refusal). The sibling tools `update_record` and `delete_record` in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` (and the stdio bridge path they reach) do not, so a stored update or delete still answers the tool's error. An agent reads that as "nothing happened" and retries; a retried update re-applies, a retried delete answers not-found and confuses the agent further.

## Wanted

- `update_record` and `delete_record` answer their existing success result for a write that landed, through the same carrier and stale-summary log line, as `create_record` does after #28843. ⛔ No new error code, result member or shape.
- One test per tool: a recompute failure after a stored write answers the tool's success result, and the write is applied once.
- Check `run_action` bodies that write (the docblock at `mcp-http-tools.ts` ~line 517 lists them together) and include any that share the gap, or name them.

Blocked-by: #28782 (PR #28843 adds the MCP-side reading this card reuses).

Dedupe: searched `mcp update_record summary recompute`; only #28782 and #28661. **New.**

Links back: #28782, PR #28843, #28661, PR #28781.
